core: Deal 100% ATK damage. On hit, gain Sixth Sense for 2 rounds.
Deal 120% ATK damage. On hit, gain 1 Hone and 1 Focus. Interrupt curses and advance mechanics.
Deal 350% ATK damage and heal for 1% of damage dealt. Use it after a successful Parry until the end of your next attack turn. During Blade Trance, use it on any attack opportunity.
Deal 600% ATK damage. Cancel the current attack or mechanic.
Evade the current attack and mechanic failure damage. Prevent new curses this turn.
parry: Reduce direct damage by 60%. Gain 1 Hone. A multi-hit attack grants Hone only once per Parry action.
Negate the hit, gain the successful Parry benefits, and gain Sharp Eye for 2 rounds. May trigger Blade Trance.
Lose 1 Energy per hit taken with the wrong parry type. Evaded hits cost no Energy.
passives: Every 2 Hone adds 1% to Perfect Parry chance, up to 70%. Above 60 Hone, every 2 extra stacks reduce direct damage taken by an additional 1%, up to 30% additional reduction.
Each Focus adds 1% to Blade Trance chance, up to 60%. Above 30 Focus, every 2 extra stacks add 1% critical damage.
Thrust deals 20% more damage for 2 rounds. Reapplying refreshes the duration instead of stacking.
Take 10% less direct damage for 2 rounds. Reapplying refreshes the duration instead of stacking.
Can trigger on a Perfect Parry. For 3 combat rounds, gain +20% critical chance, keep Thrust unlocked, and keep Sharp Eye and Sixth Sense active. Triggering Blade Trance again refreshes the duration.
